Odisha Floods Situation Improves with Over 53,000 in Relief Camps

The flood situation in Odisha is improving, though 53,986 people remain in relief camps. A third wave of floods previously impacted the Kendrapara district. In separate developments, the Odisha government provided Rs 833 crore in assistance to farmers before the rabi season. Additionally, Jio has claimed to become the market leader in Odisha with 1.85 crore subscribers.
